blocks.text: The 2026 iHeart Radio Music Festival concluded its first day with a high-energy set from K-pop supergroup BTS, featuring performances of their hits from their latest album “Arirang.” Korean superstars Jin, Suga, RM, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook took the stage at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on Friday, Sept. 18, (Sept. 19 in the Philippines). The septet began their set with “Swim,” then further energized the crowd with “2.0.” The audience got even more fired up as the group performed “Mic Drop” and “FYA.” Clips from the show as well as glimpses of BTS’ backstage interview were shared by the […]...
